query:
SELECT
                ($1::date + offset_days) AS "day!",
                (($1::date + offset_days)::timestamp AT TIME ZONE $3) AS "start!",
                (($1::date + offset_days + 1)::timestamp AT TIME ZONE $3) AS "end!"
            FROM generate_series(0, $2::date - $1::date - 1) AS offset_days
            ORDER BY 1
